verdict.rationale: Stripe documents dispute handling with Dashboard guidance and Smart Disputes, which automates evidence collection and submission. It also offers generic registrable webhook endpoints and an official MCP server that lets agents call the Stripe API, so the pieces for agent-driven dispute work exist. However, nothing documents dispute-specific events, deadline fields, or a draft-for-review workflow, and Smart Disputes auto-submits rather than drafting for human approval. missing for 10: documented dispute webhook events and API access to dispute deadlines (evidence_details/due_by), an evidence-drafting flow that pauses for user review, Terminal-specific dispute guidance, hands-on or independent corroboration.
